failure_lock_in.interpretation: The accumulated context produced a reproducible one-case lock-in, not a progressively worsening curve.

decision.conclusion: Increasing depth from five to ten did not reveal delayed degradation. Performance dropped by 0.067 at layer 6 and then remained exactly flat for five layers.
decision.mechanistic_reason: The strict 10/10 Core source gate stopped positive feedback as soon as every layer-6 worker scored 9/10. The shared bundle and prompt then became identical in size through layer 10.
decision.iteration_hypothesis: For this strict-gated cumulative mechanism, too few iterations is no longer a credible explanation. Additional identical layers cannot amplify complexity after the source bundle has frozen.
decision.next_variable: Replace omniscient external-Core source admission with a realistic local acceptance signal, such as successful agent completion plus local smoke checks, while retaining external Core only as the blinded outcome.
